subject: Operational telemetry & on-demand log extract plan for SOC 2 request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@clearskyhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: audit@clearskyhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Operational telemetry & log retention for SOC 2 review

Hi Jonas / Irene,

We are preparing for ClearSky Health's SOC 2 readiness review and need to collect evidence around Redwood's operational telemetry and admin activity logging. Can you please confirm the following items and provide any runnable export instructions or turnaround SLAs?

1) What categories of logs are retained (admin activity, API call traces, model inference logs, auth events, VPC flow logs, console audit events)?
2) Retention durations for each category and whether retention is configurable per-tenant.
3) Export formats available (NDJSON, CSV, syslog, CloudTrail-style JSON) and whether exports include original request/response bodies or are redacted by default.
4) On-demand extraction: expected lead time to produce a signed, time-stamped bundle covering a 90-day window, and chain-of-custody options (S3 presigned link, signed manifest, notarized snapshot).
5) Sampling/PII redaction options and whether we can request pre-redacted samples.
6) Any existing Playbook/Runbook we can use for ingestion into our audit evidence system.

Can you also attach a short manifest or example file showing field names? We need a response within 72 hours if possible.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Sr. Audit Manager, ClearSky Health

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Operational telemetry & log retention for SOC 2 review

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Quick note to confirm we can cover this and outline next steps below. Attaching a short manifest example for field names (telemetry_evidence_manifest_v1.csv).

High-level answers:
- Categories: admin activity (console/API keys/role changes), authentication events (login, token ops), API request traces (ingest/generate/embeddings), operator/infra telemetry (node heartbeats, scheduler events), and optional network flow logs for Private deployments.
- Retention: default 12 months for hosted telemetry; Dedicated/Private customers can request 24+ months under contract. Per-tenant adjustable where using Dedicated or Private. Hosted customers have tiered retention options (standard/extended) — we can include the table in the playbook.
- Formats: NDJSON and CloudTrail-style JSON exports are supported; CSV is supported for manifest-level extracts. Full request/response bodies are redacted by default for hosted tenants. For signed legal requests we can provide enclosed request bodies under an evidence access process with additional approvals.
- On-demand extraction SLA: standard delivery is 72 hours for metadata-only bundles, 5 business days for request/response bodies with approvals. We offer signed manifests and S3 presigned delivery; notarized snapshots require escalation and legal review.
- Redaction: we provide PII scrubbing templates (email/hash, IP anonymization); we can produce a pre-redacted sample on request (attached sample).

Next steps:
1) I'll loop in Compliance (marissa_cole) and Security (soojin_lee) for legal/chain-of-custody options.
2) Please confirm the 90-day window you want and whether you need bodies.
3) We'll produce a small sample export within 48 hours after you confirm scope.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: telemetry_evidence_manifest_v1.csv
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Operational telemetry & log retention for SOC 2 review

Adding a few compliance notes for the extraction playbook:
- For SOC 2 auditors we include a signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and a timestamped export log.
- If customer requests request/response bodies, require an amendment to the DPA and a joint custodian form; estimate 5-7 business days for evidence readiness once legal is confirmed.
- For chain-of-custody we recommend S3 presigned links + GPG-signed manifest. We maintain an internal evidence ledger (operator-trail) that records who requested and who approved the export.
- Retention policy default is 12 months for hosted. For Dedicated we can set retention policies per pool; note that very long retention (3+ years) increases storage and may require a reserved contract.

I'll draft the short playbook snippet and the sample redaction mapping (email->hash, ip->0.0.0.0/0 mask) and drop it in the playbook link.

-Marissa
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Operational telemetry & log retention for SOC 2 review

Maya — thanks again. Per the internal thread above, attached are: 1) the telemetry evidence manifest (CSV) with field names and an example row, 2) our On-Demand Extract Playbook (PDF) which contains SLA estimates, evidence packaging steps, chain-of-custody recommendations, redaction options, and the exact API call we use to trigger a metadata-only bundle.

TL;DR summary for your audit checklist:
- Categories retained: admin activity, auth events, API traces, operator telemetry (+ optional VPC flow for Private).
- Default retention: 12 months hosted; configurable to 24+ months on Dedicated/Private under contract.
- Export formats: NDJSON, CloudTrail JSON, CSV manifest. Bodies redacted by default; full bodies available under legal request.
- On-demand SLA: 72 hours metadata-only; 5 business days for full bodies with approvals; delivery via S3 presigned link and GPG-signed manifest.

Please confirm the 90-day window (example: 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-30) and whether you require request/response bodies. Once you confirm, I'll queue a sample export (metadata-only) and provide the HubSpot ticket number for tracking.

Attachments: on_demand_extract_playbook_v1.pdf, sample_admin_activity_snapshot-202609.zip

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
